title: 4/24 new 'batters away' dashboard cell went blank whenever the picked team was in the field
tier_reason: dashboard display only, live for about 15 minutes between the feature's deploy and the fix; no pick, delivery or grading effect

contract.text: While the pick's game is in progress, the upcoming-PA cell shows how many batters away the pick is, including when the picked team is fielding.

mechanism.text: extract_batter_pas used linescore current_batter as the distance reference; when the picked team was fielding, that batter belonged to the opponent, the lookup in the picked team's players failed and the status fell back to pre_game, which renders a blank cell

watchdog.trigger: display-only dashboard cell; no delivery, entry, grading, restart or preservation boundary is involved

evidence.what: with the picked batter's team in the field (a present-tense live example from that evening's game), the lookup fell back to pre_game and the dashboard cell was blank
